events.name: New Juaben North (Akwadum) Densu River flood
events.method: Sentinel-1 RTC (calibrated gamma0) VV change detection: >|3|dB drop baseline->peak, pre-existing water excluded (adaptive: max of -17 dB and the baseline's 8th percentile), blobs <8px removed. Rain-wetted soil also darkens VV -- read margins as indicative, not a surveyed flood line.
